items.reviewNote: The philosopher assures the giant that still smaller intelligent beings exist. En toute sûreté modifies croire with epistemic certainty, not bodily protection or a secure locked place. The published toute determiner and absence of a sûreté bank were checked, but the full adverbial phrase supplies the source meaning. All four phrases fit croire as manner modifiers; no doubt rather than haste, secrecy or hesitation selects en toute sûreté.
